# superlog_dashboard (Resource)

A dashboard over the workspace's telemetry. The resource owns all of the dashboard's widgets: widgets added in Superlog are removed on the next apply.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "superlog_dashboard" "checkout" {
  name = "Checkout"

  variables = [
    {
      name          = "env"
      label         = "Environment"
      attribute_key = "deployment.environment"
      options       = ["production", "staging"]
      default_value = "production"
    },
  ]

  widgets = [
    {
      title = "Errors by service"
      type  = "timeseries_count"
      # $${env} is the `env` variable; $$ keeps Terraform from reading it.
      config = jsonencode({
        source  = "logs"
        groupBy = "service.name"
        filter = {
          resourceAttrs = [{ key = "deployment.environment", value = "$${env}" }]
        }
      })
      layout = { x = 0, y = 0, w = 6, h = 4 }
    },
    {
      title  = "Request duration p95"
      type   = "timeseries_metric"
      config = jsonencode({ metricName = "http.server.duration", aggregation = "p95", unit = "duration_ms" })
      layout = { x = 6, y = 0, w = 6, h = 4 }
    },
    {
      title  = "Recent errors"
      type   = "log_table"
      config = jsonencode({ source = "logs", filter = { resourceAttrs = [{ key = "severity", value = "ERROR" }] } })
      layout = { x = 0, y = 4, w = 12, h = 6 }
    },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)

### Optional

- `variables` (Attributes List) Dropdowns shown on the dashboard. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--variables))
- `widgets` (Attributes List) The dashboard's widgets, in order. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--widgets))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `url` (String) The dashboard in Superlog.

<a id="nestedatt--variables"></a>
### Nested Schema for `variables`

Required:

- `name` (String) Widgets use the selected value when a filter value is `$name` or `${name}`.

Optional:

- `attribute_key` (String) The attribute the variable usually filters, such as `deployment.environment`.
- `default_value` (String) Must be one of `options` when there are any.
- `label` (String)
- `multi` (Boolean) Allows several values. Selecting none matches every value.
- `options` (List of String) The choices. Leave it empty to type a value.


<a id="nestedatt--widgets"></a>
### Nested Schema for `widgets`

Required:

- `config` (String) The widget's settings as JSON; use `jsonencode`. For example `{ source = "logs", groupBy = "service.name" }`, `{ metricName = "http.server.duration", aggregation = "p95" }`, or `{ markdown = "..." }`. Filters go in `filter.resourceAttrs`.
- `title` (String)
- `type` (String) `timeseries_count` counts or aggregates logs or spans, `timeseries_metric` charts one metric, `log_table` and `trace_table` list matching logs or traces, and `markdown` shows text.

Optional:

- `layout` (Attributes) Position on a 12-column grid. Without it, the widget gets the standard size for its type below the others. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--widgets--layout))

Read-Only:

- `id` (String)

<a id="nestedatt--widgets--layout"></a>
### Nested Schema for `widgets.layout`

Required:

- `h` (Number)
- `w` (Number)
- `x` (Number)
- `y` (Number)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import a dashboard by its ID, from its URL in Superlog.
terraform import superlog_dashboard.checkout 22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222
```
